headline: Senate Impeachment Trial Postponed for Second Consecutive Day Amid Flooding
seoTitle: Impeachment Trial Postponed for Second Day | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News midday brief reports that the Senate Impeachment Court postponed Day 17 for a second consecutive day because of severe weather and flooded transport routes.
deck: The second weather delay pushes the trial calendar further back as Metro Manila remains under emergency work arrangements.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News midday package reports that Presiding Officer Francis Escudero canceled the August 19 impeachment session, marking a second consecutive weather-related postponement.
The package says Day 17 was reset for Thursday, August 20, with cash-advance custodians among the expected witnesses.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The delay followed continuing monsoon flooding and the Palace directive shifting executive government work arrangements across NCR and several Luzon provinces.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Repeated postponements affect witness scheduling and the pace of a constitutional trial while prioritizing safe movement during severe weather.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the Senate Impeachment Court for the Thursday session notice, witness lineup and any makeup-session adjustments.
